note: What blind raters READ from a book's own drawings and heads when they missed — measured on real books (own-icons-sheet.js / cast-sheet.js --judge). The redraw note (lib/own-drawings.js redrawNote) quotes the rows whose intended words match. Add a row by hand after a miss, as in icon-readings.json; never add a misreading to a drawing's reads.

readings.note: the houses were the body of the picture; the road was a strip at the bottom
a coat rack names a cloakroom; a numbered front door and a stair name a flat's hallway
a hood with no hair and no open face is a parka, not a hooded woman
second round: the hair showed, the hood did not — the hood must be the one large element
the open box needed the soil heaped above its rim before it read as earth
a cloak reads as a robe unless it falls from the shoulders over the arms
